title: Fields and headings: datalist, password, selectedcontent, title and hgroup
blurb: The suggestions of a <datalist> drawn as chips on a ring round the field, a password field whose picture is only dots, the chosen option of a select drawn large from its <selectedcontent>, the page's own <title> element drawn as a heading, and a subtitle typed out under its heading.
question: What can a canvas take from a form field or a heading beyond its picture: the options of a datalist, the type of a password field, the box of a selectedcontent, the page's title element, the characters of a subtitle?
result: All five work in Chromium 157. input.list gives the options and the datalist has no box. A password field's picture is dots, the same for two values of one length. A selectedcontent has a box that a clipped draw enlarges. A title element in a canvas is drawn and still names the tab. A Range gives one rectangle per character.
